title: Protected descendant settlement
responsibility: Stops proven private command processes under a deadline while leaving shared or uncertain processes untouched and recording the outcome.

inputs.name: haltProcesses.watch
inputs.description: The tracker reads the command group and its followed descendants on each observation, returning null when they cannot be read. An unreadable read or expired deadline prevents further signaling.

inputs.name: haltProcesses.context
inputs.description: Supplies the command's process group, authority lookup and process probes used to classify followed processes. The cleanup deadline replaces its signal so in-flight looks can be cancelled when settlement ends.

inputs.name: haltProcesses.limit
inputs.description: `graceMs` is the pause after SIGTERM before the SIGKILL pass, and `deadline` bounds the reads, judgments and signals. No process is signalled after an unreadable observation or an expired deadline.

inputs.name: settleProcesses.watch
inputs.description: Reads the command group and its followed descendants after the command ends, returning null when they cannot be read. An unreadable read or expired cleanup deadline produces an unknown settlement.

inputs.name: settleProcesses.context
inputs.description: Supplies the command's process group, authority lookup and process probes used to classify followed processes. The cleanup deadline replaces its signal to stop in-flight looks when settlement ends.

inputs.name: settleProcesses.timing
inputs.description: `settleMs` is the wait for descendants that left the command group to end by themselves; `graceMs` is the pause after SIGTERM before private leftovers receive SIGKILL. `cleanupMs` bounds the whole operation; when omitted, the code uses `settleMs + graceMs + 10000` ms.

outputs.name: haltProcesses
outputs.description: Resolves after the bounded SIGTERM and SIGKILL passes, or stops when a read is unavailable or the deadline expires. It rechecks each target and signals only processes classified private; shared or uncertain processes are left alone.

outputs.name: settleProcesses
outputs.description: Resolves to a `Settlement` report after waiting up to `settleMs` for processes that left the command group to end; remaining private leftovers receive SIGTERM and then SIGKILL after `graceMs`. Vetted delegated services are handed to the system, protected or unproven leftovers are left running and fail the check, and thrown failures become unknown settlements.

examples.report: [harness] the processes could not be read or judged in time: nothing more was signalled, what the command left is unknown, and the check fails
